title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Fairfield University
description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with directly documented evening hours, spanning campus and Fairfield’s Post Road corridors. Confirm same-day service before leaving.

cards.title: A Midnight Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: Fairfield location closes at midnight Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Check the live schedule, then head to 1520 Post Road on a Friday or Saturday when its documented midnight close fits a later food run.
cards.short_summary: A weekend pizza option with a directly posted midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Colony Grill lists its Fairfield restaurant at 1520 Post Road and a midnight closing time on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Confirm same-day hours before departure; food and seating require a purchase and remain subject to restaurant policies.

cards.title: Delivery or Carryout After Dinner Hours
cards.subtitle: The store page explicitly advertises late-night pizza service
cards.notes: Open the live ordering page before choosing delivery or carryout; the cited store page supports late service but not a durable weekly timetable.
cards.short_summary: A Post Road pizza fallback whose official page specifically identifies late-night ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's identifies its Fairfield store at 1580 Post Road as offering pizza for delivery and carryout, including late-night service.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1580 Post Rd in Fairfield
cards.access_notes: The cited page does not provide a stable weekly schedule; verify ordering availability and delivery range in real time.

cards.title: The East Post Road Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Fairfield storefront backed by the company’s open-late service claim
cards.notes: Use the Fairfield site’s live Hours control before traveling to 733 Post Road; posted availability can change by day or ordering method.

cards.evidence_claim: Planet Pizza's official Fairfield site identifies its restaurant at 733 Post Road, and the company advertises its restaurants as open late.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the live closing time and available ordering method before leaving; all food requires purchase.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Drive-Thru Option
cards.subtitle: Lobby until midnight; drive-thru listed around the clock
cards.notes: Check the restaurant locator before departure, and plan around the service mode: the lobby and drive-thru have different documented schedules.
cards.short_summary: A late Post Road stop with separate official lobby and drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists the Fairfield restaurant at 536 Post Road with lobby hours through midnight daily and a 24-hour drive-thru daily.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Fairfield, CT at 536 Post Rd | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: After lobby closure, service may be drive-thru only; verify current hours and transportation suitability before going.

cards.title: An On-Campus 11 P.M. Food Stop
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday service is posted until 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the University’s posted schedule before walking over; Friday and Saturday provide the latest documented closing time at this campus venue.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dining destination with food service documented into late evening on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University lists The Levee as serving pizza, pasta, burgers, and other items, with Friday and Saturday hours from 4 p.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Campus access and dining operations may vary with the academic calendar; confirm the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Chinese Takeout Until 11:30
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday have the latest posted hours
cards.notes: Place a pickup order before the documented closing window; the official site lists Friday and Saturday service later than the rest of the week.
cards.short_summary: A Post Road takeout counter with weekend hours posted through 11:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Tai Jiang lists its address as 170 Post Road and posts hours until 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 11:30 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Tai Jiang – Chinese Food to Take Out · Fairfield, CT
cards.access_notes: This is a purchase-required takeout destination; verify same-day hours and submit the order with enough time for preparation.

cards.title: A 10 P.M. Weekend Dinner Run

cards.access_notes: The venue serves alcohol but operates as a restaurant; under-21 diners should follow current seating and reservation policies.

cards.title: Dinner Past 10 on Friday and Saturday
cards.subtitle: Weekend dinner service is posted until 10:15 p.m.

cards.access_notes: Confirm same-day kitchen hours and reservation availability; dining requires a purchase.

cards.title: The 9:30 P.M. Sushi Window
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday have the latest posted service
cards.notes: Order before the final service period rather than treating closing time as an arrival time; Friday and Saturday are posted through 9:30 p.m.

cards.evidence_claim: Fin Japanese Restaurant lists its address as 1241 Post Road and service until 9:30 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Verify same-day dine-in or carryout availability and allow preparation time before the posted closing hour.

cards.title: The Monday 11 P.M. Exception
cards.subtitle: Monday is listed later than every other day
cards.notes: Check directly before making the run: Monday carries the 11 p.m. listing, while the restaurant qualifies its schedule with “or until closing.”

cards.evidence_claim: Lantern Point Taverna lists its address as 1612 Post Road, an 11 p.m. Monday close, and 10 p.m. closes Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The venue serves alcohol but operates as a restaurant; confirm under-21 dining access and same-day closing time before visiting.

warnings: Business hours can change or be shortened for holidays, academic breaks, staffing, or kitchen cutoffs; every card directs readers to confirm same-day availability.
Several restaurants serve alcohol, but no bar or 21+-only venue is included; under21_safe indicates ordinary restaurant access, subject to current venue policy.
Coordinates are null where the supplied research did not provide defensible verified coordinates; each such card includes a destination-specific Google Maps search URL.
